text.en:
Our Mission

At Hanbros UK, our mission is to make United Kingdom to Turkey shipping straightforward, affordable and dependable for every customer — from families sending personal effects to businesses moving commercial stock. We combine the operational strength of a European logistics network with a local, human approach rooted in England.

We are committed to environmentally responsible practices: optimised load planning, reduced empty mileage, recyclable packing materials where possible, and continuous investment in fuel-efficient transport. Technology supports our work — online quotes, shipment tracking and digital customs documentation — but never replaces personal accountability.

What Guides Our Daily Work

  • Customer experience first: Clear communication in English and Turkish at every stage.
  • Compliance without compromise: Full adherence to UK, EU transit and Turkish import regulations.
  • Continuous improvement: Regular review of routes, packing standards and delivery times.
  • Community trust: Serving Turkish and British customers who rely on us for life-changing moves.

"We do not merely transport boxes — we deliver peace of mind from the UK doorstep to the Turkish address."
